newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue chips rebound in afternoon to close up.
newsitem.headline: KL blue chips rebound in afternoon to close up.

text.p: Malaysian blue-chip stocks staged a rebound on Thursday afternoon, after being down for most of the day, to close higher.
"The market fell off in the morning, but came back in the afternoon, led by some of the blue chips," said Jonathan Duckett, an institutional trader at Mohaiyani Securities.
The benchmark Composite Index closed up 5.91 points to 1189.43, and the small-cap Second Board index closed up 9.02 to 657.67.
Westmont Industries was the day's highest climber, gaining 86 cents or 21 percent to close at 4.90 ringgit.
